name: com.kawaiistudio.ksunitytools
description: Kawaii Studio editor toolset for Unity: Kawaii Studio Link (Send to Unity from the Kawaii Studio app), Menu Colorizer, Prefab Optimizer, Video Animator, Controller To Anim, GLB to FBX, Exporter, Obfuscator, NSFW Detector, Tail-to-PhysBones, Contact Scanner, Constraint Tool and custom shaders. Installs its shaders, materials and output folders into Assets/Kawaii Studio.
